question: Our 8 fl oz shampoo bottle has a 12-square-inch principal display panel. How must we declare net contents, and in what type size and position?
answer: The FDA requires that net contents be declared in a type size established in relation to the area of the principal display panel of the package. This declaration must be uniform for all packages of substantially the same size.
